name: Kimpton Pittman Hotel
insider_take: This boutique gem occupies a meticulously restored 1916 Neiman Marcus building in Deep Ellum, where Dallas's creative soul beats strongest.
whats_special: The Pittman seamlessly blends industrial heritage with modern luxury—original terrazzo floors and exposed brick walls tell the story of Dallas's fashion history, while contemporary art from local Deep Ellum artists adorns every floor. The rooftop Elm & Good bar offers stunning skyline views and craft cocktails inspired by the neighborhood's musical legacy.
pro_tip: Visit during the second Saturday of each month for the Deep Ellum Art Walk—you can explore dozens of galleries and street murals within a three-block radius of the hotel.
dont_miss: The hotel's ground-floor restaurant Elm & Good sources ingredients from Texas farms, and the lobby showcases rotating exhibitions from Deep Ellum's thriving artist community. Step outside to discover live music venues where legends like Stevie Ray Vaughan once played, plus some of Dallas's most Instagram-worthy street art murals just steps from your door.
pros: Historic boutique property with unique character and authentic Dallas charm
Prime downtown location within walking distance to major attractions and dining
Signature Kimpton amenities including pet-friendly policies and evening wine hour
Stylish rooms featuring modern amenities with vintage-inspired design elements
cons: Historic building may have smaller room sizes compared to newer hotels
Urban downtown location with typical city noise levels
